- Includes complimentary WiFi and refreshments

- Standard seating included
- Cafe car available for purchases

NIGHT TRAINS:

- Weekly pass: $250 (unlimited travel on all routes)

- Children under 12: 50% discount on base fare
- Seniors (65+): 30% discount on base fare

Note: Discounts cannot be combined. Upgrades are charged at full price.

- Online: www.intercitytrains.com
- Phone: 1-800-TRAINS-NOW

- Cash (station offices only)

- schedule_agent: Finds train and airplane timetables by searching documentation available only to it (does NOT contain pricing information). Can also find attractions in each city.
- concierge_agent: Looks up the prices (fares) for trains by searching documentation available only to it.

Given the conversation below, decide which agent should act next. Route to each agent at least once before finishing, even if an answer seems already available, so the response covers itinerary, schedule, and pricing.
